description: One market card (country x kind of work), as rebuilt every week: awards and values of the last 24 months, competition (bids, single-bid share), the top winners by awards and by value, SME share, price weight and award vs estimate, main buyers, trend, the open calls closing first and the contracts coming back in the next six months, each with its notice link, plus coverage, the page link and the citation; and the opportunity reading (firms active, median bids, single-bid share, each with its base, against the whole radar: a description of the market, never advice to bid). format=markdown returns the same card as Markdown.

country.description: ISO alpha-3 or alpha-2 code or a country name; ALL for Europe.

kind.description: Default all. procurement_advisory, statutory_audit, data_protection, hse_advisory: the subtype's card (advising public buyers on their tenders; audit of accounts; data protection officer; workplace health and safety advice), where it has one (ALL for Europe).

lang.description: Language of the page links (the data is the same). Default en.

page.description: Page of the open calls in the panel's list (25 a page). The card itself is the same on every page.

via.description: Leave this out. Set only by the radar's panel (MCP App) when the person uses its filters or 'show more' (panel), or by the site owner's own tests (dev), so that use is counted apart.

name: get_market
title: Get one market card
